segment.source: Press Fire to continue.
segment.target: 按下發射鍵繼續。

segment.source: If your craft has s-foils, you won't be able to fire when they are closed.
segment.target: 如果你的戰機配備S翼（折疊機翼），在閉合狀態下將無法開火。

segment.source: Keep your distance from enemy capital ships - their turrets can pack a punch.
segment.target: 與敵方主力艦保持距離——它們的砲塔威力驚人。

segment.source: Maintain your power levels to maximise damage done by your lasers.
segment.target: 維持你的能源水平，以最大化雷射造成的傷害。

segment.source: Rotate your shields to face the enemy for maximum protection.
segment.target: 將護盾轉向面對敵人的方向，以獲得最大防護。

segment.source: Prioritise your mission objectives carefully - sometimes, blowing stuff up isn't the answer.
segment.target: 請謹慎排定任務目標的優先順序——有時，炸毀一切並不是解決之道。

segment.source: Issue orders to your wingmen to maximise their effectiveness.
segment.target: 向你的僚機下達指令，以發揮他們的最大戰力。

segment.source: Try linking your weapons together to increase your firepower.
segment.target: 嘗試聯動你的武器，以增強瞬間火力。

segment.source: Most TIEs are fast, but unshielded - use this to your advantage.
segment.target: 多數鈦戰機速度極快但缺乏護盾——善用這一點轉化為你的優勢。

segment.source: The inflight map can provide vital information about your mission objectives.
segment.target: 飛行地圖能提供關乎任務目標的關鍵情資。

segment.source: The Pilot Proving Ground provides an opportunity to hone flying skills for new and experienced pilots alike.
segment.target: 飛行員試驗場為新進與資深飛行員提供磨練飛行技巧的絕佳機會。

segment.source: Only one system on your craft can be repaired at any one time, so prioritise your systems carefully.
segment.target: 戰機同一時間只能維修一個系統，請謹慎設定系統的維修優先順序。

segment.source: Be careful not to collide with the wreckage of any destroyed ships - you can still take damage.
segment.target: 小心不要撞上被摧毀船艦的殘骸——碰撞仍會對你造成傷害。

segment.source: Hone your combat skills by flying Historical Missions.
segment.target: 透過進行歷史任務來精進你的戰鬥技巧。

segment.source: Use your scopes to maintain awareness of other craft on the battlefield.
segment.target: 善用雷達螢幕，隨時掌握戰場上其他機艦的動態。

segment.source: The Wotan Weave is favoured by many pilots to escape from a tricky situation.
segment.target: 沃坦編織機動深受許多飛行員青睞，能助你在陷入困境時成功脫困。

segment.source: Ejecting near some types of enemy ship is likely to result in your capture.
segment.target: 在某些類型的敵艦附近彈射逃生，很可能導致你遭到俘虜。

segment.source: Plotting a hyperspace course takes a few seconds - don't leave yourself vulnerable during the jump.
segment.target: 計算超空間航線需要數秒時間——在跳躍準備期間切勿讓自己身陷險境。

segment.source: Despite what some pilots claim, moving slightly to the left is not a good evasive manoeuvre.
segment.target: 儘管有些飛行員言之鑿鑿，但「稍微向左偏一點」絕不是個好的規避動作。

segment.source: Staying fast is key to staying alive. Manage your power settings carefully to ensure you have enough engine power.
segment.target: 保持高速度是保命的關鍵。請謹慎調配能源設定，確保引擎擁有充足動力。

segment.source: At increased laser and shield power levels, less power is available for your engines.
segment.target: 提高雷射與護盾的能源水平時，可分配給引擎的動力將會減少。

segment.source: Star Destroyers are formidable in battle, but have weak spots that can be exploited.
segment.target: 滅星者在戰場上極具威脅，但仍有可供利用的弱點。

segment.source: Anticipate your enemies' movement and aim accordingly for maximum accuracy.
segment.target: 預判敵人的機動路徑並進行前置瞄準，以達到最高命中率。

segment.source: Transfer laser energy to your shields for extra protection during a fight.
segment.target: 在交戰中將雷射能量轉移至護盾，可獲得額外的護甲防禦。

segment.source: Shield energy can be used to recharge your lasers during a battle.
segment.target: 戰鬥中亦可將護盾能量用於為雷射充能。

segment.source: If you get into trouble, order your wingmen to help you out.
segment.target: 若是陷入困境，請命令僚機前來掩護支援。

segment.source: Check the repair order of your systems in the damage control screen.
segment.target: 可在損害管制畫面上查看系統的維修順序。

segment.source: You can order your wingmen to ignore a target if needed.
segment.target: 必要時，你可以命令僚機忽略特定目標。

segment.source: Mission taking too long? You can accelerate time, but use it wisely.
segment.target: 任務耗時過長？你可以加速時間，但請明智使用。

segment.source: If a mission is too difficult, call for reinforcements if available.
segment.target: 若任務難度過高，可在有支援的情況下呼叫增援。
